question: A short bar magnet is placed in the magnetic meridian with its North Pole pointing Geographical North. A neutral point is found on the equatorial line of the magnet at a distance $r$ from the center of the magnet. If the magnet is now rotated by $90^\circ$ in the horizontal plane such that its North Pole points Geographical East, what is the magnitude of the net magnetic field at the same position $r$ (where the neutral point was initially)? (Assume $B_H$ is the horizontal component of Earth's magnetic field).
